review: 703.3-1: expected strings carried reasoning; reduced to observable outcomes. Kept the library-size pair: 703.3's ordering holds whenever a step with a turn-based action begins, so no variant can switch it off; the base shows the loss before the trigger reaches the stack.
703.4a-1: A's library was empty, so A would lose at the next draw step; added one Mountain to A's library. Trimmed reasoning from an expected string.
703.4c-1: same empty-library fix (added a Mountain to A's library); trimmed reasoning from two expected strings.

703.4g-1: the die result was left random and the visit's target unset, so the base outcome was not determined; fixed the roll at 5, added the targeting decision (B's Grizzly Bears) and stated the phase-out outcome.
703.4n-1: trimmed reasoning from the no_maximum expected string.
703.4p-1: trimmed reasoning from the base expected string.
703.4q-1: expected strings carried reasoning and a stray Omnath power claim; reduced to playability verdicts and the resolution result.

scenarios.title: The draw-step turn-based action happens before state-based actions and before the draw-step trigger goes on the stack

setup.notes: Not the first turn of the game. Howling Mine is untapped. A's library is empty in the base case.

decisions: Both players pass priority in A's upkeep; the draw step begins.
Turn-based action: A draws a card for the turn. State-based actions are checked, then triggered abilities are put on the stack.
If Howling Mine's trigger is on the stack, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: A attempts to draw from an empty library and loses the game in the state-based check; Howling Mine's trigger is never put on the stack.

variants.label: one_card
variants.expected: A draws the Mountain and stays in the game through the state-based check. Howling Mine's trigger is put on the stack and resolves; A attempts to draw from an empty library and loses the game in the next state-based check.

variants.label: two_cards
variants.expected: A draws a Mountain, Howling Mine's trigger is put on the stack and resolves, and A draws the second Mountain. A has two cards in hand and the game continues.

scenarios.title: Phasing permanents of the active player phase out or in at the start of the untap step

setup.notes: Breezekeeper has phasing and is phased in. The next turn is A's.

decisions: Both players pass priority through B's end step and cleanup.
A's turn begins; the untap step begins and the turn-based action phasing is carried out.

variants.label: phases_out
variants.expected: A's Breezekeeper phases out and is treated as not existing.

variants.label: phases_in
variants.delta: Breezekeeper starts phased out, controlled by A when it phased out.
variants.expected: Breezekeeper phases in and stays phased in; it does not phase out again in the same untap step.

variants.label: opponents_creature
variants.delta: The Breezekeeper is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: B's Breezekeeper stays phased in.

scenarios.title: Day becomes night when the previous turn's active player cast no spells

setup.notes: It is day. B has cast no spells this turn so far. Avabruck Caretaker has daybound. The next turn is A's.

decisions: Base: B casts nothing; both players pass through B's end step and cleanup.
A's turn begins; the untap step begins, phasing is done, and the day/night check is made.

variants.label: no_spells
variants.expected: It becomes night. A's Avabruck Caretaker transforms into Hollowhenge Huntmaster (6/6).

variants.label: one_spell
variants.delta: B casts Grizzly Bears, tapping both Forests, in main2 and it resolves.
variants.expected: It stays day. Avabruck Caretaker stays a 4/4.

scenarios.title: Night becomes day when the previous turn's active player cast two or more spells

setup.notes: It is night, and A's Avabruck Caretaker is on its night face, Hollowhenge Huntmaster (6/6). B has cast no spells this turn so far. The next turn is A's.

decisions: B casts Dwarven Trader, tapping a Mountain; both players pass; it resolves.
B casts the second Dwarven Trader, tapping the other Mountain; both players pass; it resolves.
Both players pass through B's end step and cleanup; A's untap step begins and the day/night check is made.

variants.label: two_spells
variants.expected: It becomes day. A's Hollowhenge Huntmaster transforms into Avabruck Caretaker (4/4).

variants.label: one_spell
variants.delta: B casts only one Dwarven Trader.
variants.expected: It stays night. A's creature stays Hollowhenge Huntmaster (6/6).

scenarios.forge_notes: Setup requires the night designation and the back face on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: The active player untaps their permanents during the untap step
decisions: Both players pass priority through B's end step and cleanup.
A's turn begins; the untap step turn-based action untaps A's permanents.

variants.label: own_permanent
variants.expected: A's Grizzly Bears untaps.

variants.label: opponents_permanent
variants.delta: The tapped Grizzly Bears is controlled by B, not A.
variants.expected: B's Grizzly Bears stays tapped.

variants.label: does_not_untap
variants.delta: A's tapped permanent is Grim Monolith instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Grim Monolith stays tapped.

scenarios.title: The active player draws a card as the draw step begins

setup.notes: Not the first turn of the game. Necropotence says "Skip your draw step" and refers to its controller, B.

decisions: Both players pass priority in A's upkeep.
The draw step begins and the turn-based action is carried out.

variants.label: draw_step
variants.expected: A draws one Mountain: A has one card in hand and one in library.

variants.label: skipped
variants.delta: Necropotence is controlled by A instead of B.
variants.expected: A's draw step is skipped: A has no cards in hand and two in library.

scenarios.title: The active player adds a lore counter to each of their Sagas as the precombat main phase begins

setup.notes: History of Benalia has chapters I, II and III; it has one lore counter and chapter I has already resolved.

decisions: Both players pass priority in A's draw step.
A's precombat main phase begins; the turn-based action adds lore counters.
Chapter II's trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: own_saga
variants.expected: History of Benalia gets a second lore counter. Chapter II triggers and creates a 2/2 white Knight token with vigilance under A's control.

variants.label: opponents_saga
variants.delta: The History of Benalia is controlled by B.
variants.expected: B's History of Benalia keeps one lore counter and no chapter ability triggers.

scenarios.title: The active player rolls to visit their Attractions as the precombat main phase begins

setup.notes: Ferris Wheel is an Attraction with lights 4, 5 and 6. The die result is fixed at 5. B's Grizzly Bears is the only creature on the battlefield.

decisions: Both players pass priority in A's draw step.
A's precombat main phase begins; lore counters are placed (none), then A rolls to visit their Attractions and the die shows 5.
If Ferris Wheel's visit ability triggers, A targets Grizzly Bears; both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: controls_attraction
variants.expected: A rolls a six-sided die (5). Ferris Wheel's visit ability triggers and resolves: B's Grizzly Bears phases out.

variants.label: opponents_attraction
variants.delta: Ferris Wheel is controlled by B.
variants.expected: A rolls no die; no visit ability triggers and Grizzly Bears stays phased in.

scenarios.forge_notes: The roll is random in Forge; a harness must fix the die result at 5.

scenarios.title: Combat damage is dealt simultaneously
decisions: A attacks B with Grizzly Bears.
B blocks it with Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass through the declare blockers step; the combat damage step begins and each creature assigns its 2 damage to the other.

variants.label: both_deal_damage
variants.expected: Both Grizzly Bears deal 2 damage at the same time; both have lethal damage and both are put into their owners' graveyards.

variants.label: first_strike_blocker
variants.delta: B's blocker is Youthful Knight (first strike) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Youthful Knight deals 2 damage in the first-strike damage step and A's Grizzly Bears is destroyed; it deals no damage and Youthful Knight survives undamaged.

scenarios.title: The active player discards down to maximum hand size in the cleanup step

setup.notes: Reliquary Tower says "You have no maximum hand size" and refers to its controller, B.

decisions: Both players pass priority in A's end step.
The cleanup step begins; A discards down to the maximum hand size, choosing to discard Grizzly Bears if a discard is needed.

variants.label: eight_cards
variants.expected: A has eight cards and discards Grizzly Bears: seven cards remain in hand and Grizzly Bears is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: seven_cards
variants.delta: A's hand has only seven cards (six Mountains and Grizzly Bears).
variants.expected: A discards nothing and keeps all seven cards.

variants.label: no_maximum
variants.delta: Reliquary Tower is controlled by A instead of B.
variants.expected: A discards nothing and keeps all eight cards.

scenarios.title: Damage is removed and until-end-of-turn effects end simultaneously in the cleanup step
decisions: A casts Giant Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping a Forest; both players pass; it resolves.
B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the Mountain; both players pass; it resolves.
Both players pass priority through the rest of the turn; the cleanup step begins.

variants.label: until_end_of_turn
variants.expected: Before cleanup Grizzly Bears is 5/5 with 3 damage. In the cleanup step it becomes a 2/2 with no damage marked and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: counters
variants.delta: A's spell is Dragonscale Boon (tapping four Forests) instead of Giant Growth.
variants.expected: Before cleanup Grizzly Bears is 4/4 with 3 damage. In the cleanup step the damage is removed but the two +1/+1 counters stay: it is a 4/4 with no damage.

scenarios.forge_notes: If the +3/+3 ended before the damage was removed, the 2/2 with 3 damage would die; the scenario checks that it does not.

scenarios.title: Unspent mana empties from mana pools as each step and phase ends

setup.notes: Omnath's ability applies to its controller's mana, B.

decisions: A taps the Forest for G in the precombat main phase; the G stays in A's mana pool.
Both players pass with an empty stack; the beginning of combat step begins.
A tries to cast Giant Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, paying with the mana already in the pool.

variants.label: next_step
variants.expected: A's mana pool is empty in the beginning of combat step: casting Giant Growth is not playable (its cost cannot be paid).

variants.label: same_step
variants.delta: A casts Giant Growth in the precombat main phase, in the same phase the mana was added.
variants.expected: Casting Giant Growth is playable; it resolves and Grizzly Bears is 5/5 until end of turn.

variants.label: mana_does_not_empty
variants.delta: Omnath, Locus of Mana is controlled by A instead of B.
variants.expected: The G stays in A's mana pool into the beginning of combat step: casting Giant Growth is playable; it resolves and Grizzly Bears is 5/5 until end of turn.
